title: UBA's New Free Dental Plan: Access Now
text:
Are you looking for accessible healthcare and essential services in Buenos Aires? The University of Buenos Aires (UBA) is offering free dental care, ophthalmological services, and more through its “UBA in Action” program. Learn how you can benefit from these valuable resources and access free dental and other crucial services.
University of Buenos Aires Offers Free Services too the Community April 9, 2025
The University of Buenos aires is extending its reach beyond academia, providing free dental, ophthalmological, and other essential services to the community. this initiative, “UBA in Action,” addresses critical needs and offers valuable training opportunities for students.
The Free Dentistry Service will be available until April 12 in Plaza Houssay . Free Dental Care in Plaza Houssay The University of Buenos Aires (UBA) has launched a program offering free dental care at Plaza Houssay for individuals without social work or those facing difficulties obtaining dental appointments.
this service, a blend of student practise and community outreach, is available until April 12. Attention is provided from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. Registration is required at the on-site stand.
Key details:
What: Free dental care Where: Plaza Houssay (between Recoleta and Balvanera, Buenos Aires) When: Until April 12, 9 a.m. – 12 p.m. Who: Open to those without social work or facing appointment difficulties. Ophthalmological Controls Also Available In addition to dental services, free ophthalmological controls are also being offered as part of the UBA in action program.
The program aims to provide various free services to the public, including legal advice, psychological support, workshops, and accounting guidance.
Following the ophthalmological evaluations, approximately 50 pairs of glasses will be distributed to those in need.
How to request Appointments Due to high demand,interested individuals must request an appointment via WhatsApp at 11 3758-9941. The institution has specified that appointments are exclusively managed through WhatsApp messages; telephone calls will not be answered.
Shifts are only managed through messages from WhatsApp and they will not attend telephone calls.
University of Buenos aires
Free repellent Distribution the UBA organized a delivery of repellents elaborated in a joint work between the Faculty of Pharmacy and Biochemistry. Amid concerns over rising dengue cases, the UBA is also distributing free repellent, developed in collaboration between the Faculty of Pharmacy and Biochemistry.
Prior registration via WhatsApp is required to access the repellent, which combats the Aedes Aegypti mosquito, the transmitter of dengue.
Teachers and students will conduct six solidarity days between November 11 and 16, offering services to vulnerable neighborhoods through the UBA in action program. Repellents can be collected on Saturdays in Plaza Houssay after prior registration.
“UBA in Action”: A Comprehensive Program The high demand for these services underscores the positive impact of UBA in action , not only on the community’s health but also on the professional growth of UBA students.
The program offers a wide array of services throughout the week:
Monday: Dental Care Tuesday: Dental Attention and Blood Analysis Wednesday: Dental care Thursday: Medical, dental, and ophthalmological care; psychological care; legal advice; veterinary services and castration; repellent delivery Friday: Dental Care Saturday: Extensive services including repellent delivery, medical and dental care, ophthalmological optics, economic and legal advice, cardiovascular risk factor assessment, weight and blood pressure checks, glycemia testing, nutritional counseling, addiction prevention, scholarship information, psychological care, museum network access, UBA XXI advice, primary care for canines and felines, anti-rabies vaccination, drawing workshops, coexistence advice, vocational guidance, electrocardiogram advice, CPR talks, vaccine information, blood factor testing, HIV tests, kinesiological counseling, physical exams, and podological care.
